title: Bank of America kindly asks that you don’t share your banking password with your AI assistant
slides: Why is Bank of America warning you about AI assistants?
They say sharing your banking password is a security risk.
But most AI assistants already have access to your data anyway.
Review your AI assistant's permissions and disable banking access now.
Your password is the one secret that should never be shared.
thread_text:
1. The AI warning nobody expected

Bank of America is now warning customers that sharing banking passwords with AI assistants is a security risk — even as those same assistants already have access to your data.

2. Your assistant already knows too much

Most AI assistants have broad permissions that let them read messages, emails, and even financial apps. The password is just one piece of a much larger exposure.

3. The password myth

You might think your password is safe if you never type it into a chat. But assistants can access saved passwords and autofill data without you ever sharing them directly.

4. Banks can't protect you here

If an AI assistant with banking access is compromised, the bank may not cover your losses. Their warning is a signal: you're on your own to secure that connection.

5. Check your permissions today

Open your AI assistant's settings, review which apps have access, and disable banking or financial connections now. Your password should never be shared — but your permissions matter just as much.
